title: Mac Miller’s Estate Releases 10th-Anniversary Edition of ‘The Divine Feminine’ With 3 New Songs
summary: Mac's amorous exploration debuted at No. 2 on the Billboard 200 in 2016.
contentText:
Mac Miller’s estate has released a three-pack of new songs as part of The Divine Feminine ‘s 10th anniversary edition, which arrived on Friday (Oct. 2).

A previously unreleased single titled “Butterflies” was released in September, while “Grand” and “Channel 13” hit streaming services for the first time on Friday.

Mac’s family is also celebrating the LP’s 10th anniversary with The Divine Feminine Live , which will be based on the original TV series from 2016 that was exclusive to DirecTV. Fans can stream TDF Live on Mac Miller’s YouTube starting at 10 p.m. ET on Friday night.

Sam Balaban will be producing, directing and editing the live special, while Bart Peters serves as the original live performance director. There will be contributions from E. Dan and Justin Boyd as well.

View this post on Instagram

The Divine Feminine arrived in September 2016 and debuted at No. 2 on the Billboard 200 with 48,000 total album-equivalent units earned. TDF featured Mac’s new girlfriend at the time and pop supernova Ariana Grande , Anderson .Paak , Kendrick Lamar, Ty Dolla $ign and CeeLo Green.

Album standout “Cinderella” experienced a massive resurgence this summer, as a TikTok trend caused the Ty Dolla $ign-assisted eight-minute expedition exploring love and lust to explode and reach the Billboard Hot 100, where it peaked at No. 25. It’s Mac’s second-highest charting single as a lead artist and still surging as “Cinderella” also hit the top 10 of the latest Rhythmic Airplay chart.
